issue_context.title: Add support for collectors updating their metadata
issue_context.body:
Add support for collectors updating their metadata.

When a collector begins it will update those structures (rrdset/rrddim) with more up-to-date information.

##### Cases

- `CHART name title family context charttype priority update_every options plugin module`
What cannot be updated for CHART is:
    - `type.id units`

- `DIMENSION name algorithm multiplier divisor options`
What cannot be updated for DIMENSION is:
   - `id`

- `HOST hostname registry_hostname update_every os timezone tags system_info`
What cannot be updated for HOST is:
   - `GUID`

##### Steps

- Atomically update the in-memory data structures.
- Write the updates to the metadata log as new records.

review_comments: This is correct - the other cases have the redundant `if`.
We don't want the pause if the collector sent the CHART again but nothing changed.
Should we do ACLK updates as well?
